title: Anatomy-Conserving Unpaired CBCT-to-CT Translation via Schrödinger Bridge
tldr_zh: UNSB 骨架 + AC-ViT 生成器 + 焦点频率损失做无配对 CBCT→CT，跨区泛化最好，但只报像素指标
tldr_en: UNSB-style Schrödinger bridge with an AC-ViT generator and focal frequency loss for unpaired CBCT-to-CT; best PSNR/MAE intra- and cross-region, pixel metrics only.
key_numbers: Chest->Chest: ACSB PSNR 31.457 / MAE 2.018 vs UNSB 31.187 / 2.080, CUT 31.381 / 2.054 (Table 1)
Cross-region H&N->Chest: ACSB MAE 3.203 vs UNSB 5.184, SynDiff 9.528 (Table 2)
Cross-region Chest->H&N: ACSB MAE 2.980 vs UNSB 3.030, SynDiff 20.921 (Table 2)
Train 2,232 / test 480 registered CBCT-CT slice pairs, shuffled for unpaired training (Sec. 3.1)
